content_blocks.title: Worked example: Host Header and URL Validation
content_blocks.code:
from flask import Flask

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config.update(
    SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY=True,
    SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE="Lax",
    MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH=2 * 1024 * 1024,
    TRUSTED_HOSTS=["localhost", "127.0.0.1"],
)
content_blocks.expected_output: The app uses HttpOnly and SameSite session-cookie settings, caps request size at 2 MiB, and restricts accepted Host values to the development hosts shown.
